newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-SAMPRAS KNOCKED OUT OF FRENCH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SAMPRAS KNOCKED OUT OF FRENCH OPEN.

text.p: World number one Pete Sampras was knocked out of the French Open in the third round on Friday when he was beaten 6-2 6-4 2-6 6-4 by Sweden's Magnus Norman.
The top-seeded Sampras, 25, has collected nine grand slam titles but has still never won at Roland Garros where his best performance was a semifinal appearance last year.
Sampras, in superb form in his opening two rounds, was weakened by a pre-match stomach upset as he went down to Norman, who was celebrating his 21st birthday.
Norman triumphed in two and a half hours, converting the first of three match points to end a potential Sampras comeback from the wasteland of two sets down.
